- **One assumption:** Tobias's message only says "his dealer account," not Marrow Fieldworks by name. I linked the two using a public handoff note saying Marrow Fieldworks changed hands on 5 Jan 2026. The note doesn't name the new owner, but the details fit Tobias. I told Pree that and suggested she confirm with Tobias before the customer call.
- **What I couldn't check:** The account files folder came back empty, so there was no ticket record to check against.
